sources.source_name: XBRL International filings.xbrl.org structured filing index
limitations: Keyless and free, but the index is not a complete global filing universe and currently omits some ESEF jurisdictions.
The processed timestamp is treated as a conservative availability proxy; original regulator publication timing must be certified before historical decision reliance.
Structured filing discovery supports fundamentals and issuer evidence but never independently authorizes capital.

sources.source_name: U.S. Treasury TIC monthly cross-border long-term securities holdings
limitations: Monthly cross-border portfolio statistics are lagged and are not a real-time capital-flow tape.
The current table does not expose a machine-readable row publication timestamp, so retrieval time is preserved as the conservative availability boundary.
Country holdings and transactions are macro/positioning evidence and require causal and market confirmation before candidate economics change.

sources.source_name: Coin Metrics Community API on-chain network metrics
limitations: No API key is required, but the free Community API is licensed for non-commercial use; this binding is deliberately disabled pending an explicit usage-rights determination.
Community coverage is a subset of Coin Metrics professional coverage and must never be treated as complete crypto-market data.
If enabled after rights review, records remain shadow research evidence until point-in-time history and metric availability are certified.
